messages:
Maya (docs): Quick heads-up 1 PR #10234 has a billing example that lumps generation + embeddings into one line item. We should split it and show list vs post-discount math.
Owen B: Can you paste the snippet so I can fix it in the PR?
Maya (docs): Current block: 
```
Request: generate 256 tokens + 1 embedding
Doc math: 256 * $0.00002 = $0.00512 + 1 * $0.00040 = $0.00040 -> Total $0.00552
```
This makes people assume discounts apply to both components equally and skips rounding/aggregation notes.
Lex (billing): Good catch. Our meters emit `generation.tokens` and `embeddings.units` separately. For Dedicated customers reserved discounts typically apply to generation only. Also, token rounding is per-request; embeddings may be aggregated in the billing window.
Maya (docs): Proposed replacement (concise): 
```
Illustrative example (for docs):
Request: generate 256 tokens + 1 embedding
List prices:
  generation = 256 tokens * $0.00002/token = $0.00512
  embeddings = 1 * $0.00040 = $0.00040
  list subtotal = $0.00552
Example reserved discount (generation only, illustrative 10%):
  discounted generation = $0.00512 * 0.9 = $0.004608
  total after discount = $0.004608 + $0.00040 = $0.005008 (~$0.00501)
Notes: tokens are rounded per request; embedding charges can be aggregated per billing window. Label all discounts as illustrative.
```
Owen B: Nice. Can you also add a one-line SDK snippet so engineers can map requests to meter events?
Maya (docs): Sure, suggested Node snippet: 
```js
// Node example
await client.responses.create({ model: 'rw-instruct-1', input: 'Summarize' });
await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'rw-embed-1', input: '...' });
// Billing emits: generation.tokens and embeddings.units
```
Lex (billing): Add a tiny 3-row matrix to clarify which discounts typically apply: Hosted = list rates; Dedicated = generation may be reserved; Private = contract dependent. Also add a Console screenshot caption showing the two separate panels (Generation vs Embeddings).
Priya K: I'll update PR copy and include links to the metering glossary for `token` and `embedding unit`. Also change heading from "Tier crossover" to "Mixed-workload billing example" per docs style.
Maya (docs): Pushed commit with the example, SDK snippet, and heading change. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/10234 :eyes:
CI-Bot: docs/build -> succeeded (https://ci.internal.redwood/docs/10234) :white_check_mark:
Owen B: One small nit 1 use a conservative illustrative discount (10%) and explicitly mark it as example. Looks good to me.
Lex (billing): LGTM, thanks.
Maya (docs): Thanks everyone, merging after backport pass. :thumbsup:
